# CLI reference

Every command runs on the project given by `--root` (default: the current folder), written before the command name: `cg --root ~/code/shop impact cancel_order`. `cg COMMAND --help` prints the same text.

Values in **Default** apply when the option is left out. The JSON answers of the main commands are described in [Formats](formats.md).

- **Start here:** [`start`](#start) · [`locate`](#locate) · [`search`](#search) · [`impact`](#impact) · [`verify`](#verify) · [`review`](#review)
- **Explore:** [`find`](#find) · [`show`](#show) · [`callers`](#callers) · [`callees`](#callees) · [`path`](#path) · [`context`](#context) · [`source`](#source) · [`map`](#map) · [`flows`](#flows) · [`architecture`](#architecture) · [`features`](#features) · [`prepare`](#prepare) · [`explore`](#explore) · [`export`](#export)
- **Index and maintenance:** [`index`](#index) · [`stats`](#stats) · [`check`](#check) · [`dead`](#dead) · [`catalog`](#catalog) · [`selftest`](#selftest)
- **Agents:** [`mcp`](#mcp) · [`change`](#change)

## Start here

### start

Start here: index the project and show what to ask it, with ready commands.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] start [-h] [--json] [--lang {en,it}]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |
| `--lang` `LANG` | language of the guide (default: from the environment) |  | en, it |

### locate

From the text of a request to the places to change, their callers and tests; no model calls.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] locate [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--json] text
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | the request, issue or stack trace, as text |  |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | candidate places to return, 1-10 | `5` |  |
| `--max-chars` `MAX_CHARS` | budget for the whole answer in characters, 512-16000 | `5000` |  |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |

### search

Find the code for a request: full-text BM25 over names, paths, signatures and bodies, fused with the call graph.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] search [-h] [--mode {hybrid,lexical}] [--limit LIMIT] [--depth {1,2,3}] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--json] query
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | words to search; word roots and synonyms widen it when exact words miss |  |  |
| `--mode` `MODE` | hybrid (text and graph, default) or lexical (text only) | `hybrid` | hybrid, lexical |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | results to return | `10` |  |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | graph steps from the best text matches, 1-3 | `2` | 1–3 |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `--max-chars` `MAX_CHARS` | budget for the whole answer in characters | `9000` |  |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |

### impact

What breaks if this changes: callers up to a depth, each with its callsite, and the tests reached.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] impact [-h] [--file] [--depth DEPTH] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--limit LIMIT] [--json] target
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | symbol, or a file path with --file |  |  |
| `--file` | TARGET is a file: impact of every definition in it |  |  |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | caller levels to follow | `3` |  |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | callers to show | `40` |  |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |

### verify

Tests that reach a function or file, proposed and never run.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] verify [-h] [--file] [--plan] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--depth {1,2,3,4,5}] [--json] target
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | symbol, or a file path with --file |  |  |
| `--file` | TARGET is a file |  |  |
| `--plan` | accepted for compatibility; verify always proposes tests and never runs them |  |  |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | caller levels to follow | `3` | 1–5 |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |

### review

What a change touched: signatures, calls and findings compared with a base, plus a test plan.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] review [-h] [--base BASE] [--staged] [--baseline BASELINE] [--save-baseline SAVE_BASELINE] [--force] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--depth {1,2,3,4,5}] [--json] [--summary]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--base` `BASE` | Git revision to compare with, e.g. HEAD or main |  |  |
| `--staged` | review only staged changes |  |  |
| `--baseline` `BASELINE` | compare findings with a baseline file saved earlier |  |  |
| `--save-baseline` `SAVE_BASELINE` | save the current findings to this file |  |  |
| `--force` | overwrite the file given to --save-baseline |  |  |
| `--max-chars` `MAX_CHARS` | budget for the whole answer in characters | `20000` |  |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | caller levels for the test plan | `3` | 1–5 |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |
| `--summary` | with --json: a compact answer (base, counts, new findings, tests with commands, limits); text output is already a summary |  |  |

## Explore

### find

Find definitions by name; * matches any characters.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] find [-h] [--kind KIND] [--limit LIMIT] pattern
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | name or qualified name, e.g. cancel_* or Order.cancel |  |  |
| `--kind` `KIND` | only this kind: function, method, class, ... |  |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | results to show | `40` |  |

One definition: file, lines, signature, callers and callees.


|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | name or qualified name |  |  |

### context

Source of a function with the callers, callees and tests an agent needs, within a budget.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] context [-h] [--budget BUDGET] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--json] [--profile {understand,change,debug,review}] [--line LINE] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] symbol
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `symbol` | name or qualified name |  |  |
| `--budget` `BUDGET` | budget in tokens (about 4 characters each) | `2500` |  |
| `--max-chars` `MAX_CHARS` | budget in characters; overrides --budget |  |  |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |
| `--profile` `PROFILE` | what the context is for: understand, change, debug or review | `change` | understand, change, debug, review |
| `--line` `LINE` | pick the definition that contains this line when the name is ambiguous |  |  |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `medium` | high, medium, low |

Write an offline interactive HTML page of the call graph.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] export [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--symbol SYMBOL] [--depth {1,2,3,4,5}] [--min-conf {high,medium,low}] [--max-nodes MAX_NODES] [--max-edges MAX_EDGES] [--force]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--output` `OUTPUT` | .html path inside the root (default: .code-graph/explore.html) | `.code-graph/explore.html` |  |
| `--symbol` `SYMBOL` | export only the neighbourhood of this symbol |  |  |
| `--depth` `DEPTH` | steps around --symbol | `2` | 1–5 |
| `--min-conf` `MIN_CONF` | lowest edge confidence to follow: high, medium or low | `low` | high, medium, low |
| `--max-nodes` `MAX_NODES` | stop above this many nodes | `5000` |  |
| `--max-edges` `MAX_EDGES` | stop above this many edges | `50000` |  |
| `--force` | replace an existing HTML file |  |  |

## Index and maintenance

### index

Build or refresh the index (only files whose content changed are re-parsed).

```text
cg [--root ROOT] index [-h] [--full]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--full` | rebuild every file instead of only the changed ones |  |  |

### stats

Size of the index: files, lines, definitions, calls and edges by confidence.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] stats [-h] [--json]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |

### check

Static candidates for defects: wrong argument counts, missing methods, call cycles between files, PHP name clashes.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] check [-h] [--limit LIMIT] [--json] [--include-diagnostics]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | findings to show | `60` |  |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |
| `--include-diagnostics` | also list parser and analysis diagnostics |  |  |

### dead

Definitions nothing calls in the graph, with a verdict on how sure that is.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] dead [-h] [--all] [--limit LIMIT]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | also show ambiguous and unverified candidates |  |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | candidates to show | `60` |  |

### catalog

API catalog: check (what the index uses that the catalog does not know) or validate.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] catalog [-h] [--json] [--limit LIMIT] {check,validate}
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog_command` | check or validate |  | check, validate |
| `--json` | print the machine-readable JSON answer |  |  |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | entries to show | `40` |  |

### selftest

Run the built-in parser and call-resolution checks.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] selftest [-h]
```

No options.

## Agents

### mcp

MCP server on stdio for Codex, Claude Code and other clients (read-only tools).

```text
cg [--root ROOT] mcp [-h]
```

No options.

### change

Guided change with agents: plan, approval, isolated edit, tests and a review by the other model.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change [-h] ACTION ...
```

| Action | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`new`](#change-new) | open a change from an intent; nothing runs yet |
| [`list`](#change-list) | changes in this project and their state |
| [`show`](#change-show) | state, plan, tests and review of a change |
| [`plan`](#change-plan) | ask the author for a plan grounded in the graph |
| [`approve`](#change-approve) | approve the plan and the exact test command; the tests run once now as the baseline |
| [`edit`](#change-edit) | let the author edit in its isolated worktree |
| [`verify`](#change-verify) | re-index, run the approved tests on the edit, compare with the baseline and review the diff statically |
| [`review`](#change-review) | ask the reviewer to read the diff |
| [`integrate`](#change-integrate) | bring the reviewed change into its branch, or merge it with --merge |
| [`discard`](#change-discard) | drop a change that is not integrated: its worktree and branch are removed, the archive is kept |
| [`cancel`](#change-cancel) | stop the step that is running |

#### change new

Open a change from an intent; nothing runs yet.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change new [-h] --intent INTENT --author {codex,claude} --reviewer {codex,claude} [--allow-dirty] [--budget-usd BUDGET_USD]
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--intent` `INTENT` | what the change should do, in words | required |  |
| `--author` `AUTHOR` | model that plans and edits | required | codex, claude |
| `--reviewer` `REVIEWER` | model that reviews; normally the other one | required | codex, claude |
| `--allow-dirty` | start although the checkout has uncommitted changes |  |  |
| `--budget-usd` `BUDGET_USD` | spending cap passed to Claude when it is the author or reviewer |  |  |

#### change list

Changes in this project and their state.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change list [-h]
```

No options.

#### change show

State, plan, tests and review of a change.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change show [-h] id
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |

#### change plan

Ask the author for a plan grounded in the graph.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change plan [-h] [--yes] id
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |
| `--yes` | Confirm starting the agent and sending context to its provider |  |  |

#### change approve

Approve the plan and the exact test command; the tests run once now as the baseline.

```text
cg [--root ROOT] change approve [-h] --test-argv TEST_ARGV [--no-tests-reason NO_TESTS_REASON] id
```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |
| `--test-argv` `TEST_ARGV` | test command as a JSON list of arguments, never a shell string | required |  |
| `--no-tests-reason` `NO_TESTS_REASON` | why an empty test command is acceptable |  |  |

#### change edit

Let the author edit in its isolated worktree.

```text

```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |
| `--yes` | Confirm starting the agent and sending context to its provider |  |  |
| `--feedback` `FEEDBACK` | what to change in a new edit round |  |  |

Re-index, run the approved tests on the edit, compare with the baseline and review the diff statically.

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |

Ask the reviewer to read the diff.

```text

```

| Argument | Meaning | Default | Values |

#### change integrate

Bring the reviewed change into its branch, or merge it with --merge.

|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | change id, as printed by new and list |  |  |
| `--merge` | merge into the base branch instead of leaving a branch |  |  |
| `--force-reason` `FORCE_REASON` | why to integrate although the review or the tests block it |  |  |
